tables.name: discovery_preferences
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX discovery_preferences_pkey ON public.discovery_preferences USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: fic_club_members
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (club_id) REFERENCES fic_clubs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fic_club_members_pkey ON public.fic_club_members USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fic_club_members_club_id_user_id_key ON public.fic_club_members USING btree (club_id, user_id)
CREATE INDEX fic_club_members_club_id_idx ON public.fic_club_members USING btree (club_id)
CREATE INDEX fic_club_members_user_id_idx ON public.fic_club_members USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: fic_clubs
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fic_clubs_pkey ON public.fic_clubs USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX fic_clubs_story_id_idx ON public.fic_clubs USING btree (story_id)
CREATE INDEX fic_clubs_creator_id_idx ON public.fic_clubs USING btree (creator_id)

tables.name: official_signup_tokens
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX official_signup_tokens_pkey ON public.official_signup_tokens USING btree (singleton)

tables.name: post_likes
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (post_id) REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX post_likes_pkey ON public.post_likes USING btree (post_id, user_id)
CREATE INDEX post_likes_user_id_idx ON public.post_likes USING btree (user_id)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER social_notify_insert AFTER INSERT ON public.post_likes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION social_interaction_notification()

tables.name: posts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (chapter_id) REFERENCES chapters(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX posts_pkey ON public.posts USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX posts_user_id_idx ON public.posts USING btree (user_id)
CREATE INDEX posts_created_at_idx ON public.posts USING btree (created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX posts_chapter_id_idx ON public.posts USING btree (chapter_id)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER social_notify_insert AFTER INSERT ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION social_interaction_notification()

tables.name: profile_themes
constraints:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof(drafts) = 'array'::text) THEN (jsonb_array_length(drafts) <= 12)
    ELSE false
END)
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profile_themes_pkey ON public.profile_themes USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: social_stories
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX social_stories_pkey ON public.social_stories USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX social_stories_user_id_idx ON public.social_stories USING btree (user_id)
CREATE INDEX social_stories_expires_at_idx ON public.social_stories USING btree (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX social_stories_created_at_idx ON public.social_stories USING btree (created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX social_stories_media_url_idx ON public.social_stories USING btree (media_url)

tables.name: story_daily_engagement
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (reader_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX story_daily_engagement_pkey ON public.story_daily_engagement USING btree (story_id, reader_id, activity_day)
CREATE INDEX story_daily_reader_idx ON public.story_daily_engagement USING btree (reader_id)
CREATE INDEX story_daily_day_idx ON public.story_daily_engagement USING btree (activity_day, story_id)
